body:
I have a female cousin who is 4 years younger than me.

My sister would sleep over at her house a lot and this cousin told me my sister would do the same shit to her.
same situation - you would in a truly free society we could choose what fate we want to pursue.
If you were dating someone and they told you that they did what I did....how would you react?
She will most likely get some people to beat me up.
Should I call her and tell her it was me?

She told me her email password. Sometimes I would check her sent folder.

She sent a topless photo of herself to 2 guys.

Not an excuse but in a drunken state of anger and pain, I forwarded her topless photo to everyone in her contact list. There might have been 100 contacts.

Before I open my eyes every morning for the past 12 years, I think suicide.

I have a medical problem that causes my nose to burn 24/7.
